title: mcp-ui-probe journey storage path traversal (CVE-2026-19270)
summary: mcp-ui-probe (npm) up to 0.2.0: the get_journey/delete_journey/analyze_journey/usage_stats functions in src/journey/JourneyStorage.ts pass the journeyId/filename arguments into filesystem paths without sanitization, allowing path traversal outside the journey storage directory. The project was informed through a public issue but has not responded and no fixed release exists, so the range is recorded as last_affected 0.2.0 per the public advisory.
